cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

index_pattern.description: Index or data stream pattern to investigate (e.g. logs-app.payments-*, .ds-metrics-k8s-*). Required.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM elastic-cloud-logs-8
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE event.dataset LIKE "elasticsearch.audit*"
| WHERE event.action == "access_denied"
| EVAL url_index = SUBSTRING(url.original, 2)
| WHERE (elasticsearch.index.name LIKE ?index_pattern OR url_index LIKE ?index_pattern)
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(5 minutes, @timestamp), user.name, source.ip, event.action, url.original
| SORT bucket DESC, count DESC
| LIMIT 50

description: Count access_denied audit events targeting the specified index, grouped by user, source IP, and time bucket. Matches via both the index name field and the request URL path.
